purpose: The F-54 closure measure: distinct --ds-* names DECLARED by the three tracked composed per-vertical bundles (artifacts/generated/css/verticals/*), intersection over union, which must stay at or above the fiche threshold of 90% (a code constant, not a pin). residual is the by-name adjudication of every name not every bundle declares, with the verticals allowed to declare it.
direction: Shrink-only. A residual name may disappear or become shared (a notice, not a failure). A tenant-only name not listed here, or a listed name declared by a vertical outside its declaredBy, fails closed; it enters only through a reviewed lot citing its owner-ratified identity authoring.
ruling: WO-EVI-02 F-54 clause 1, kimi-dt 2026-10-08 (roadmap commit fabb9f0a6): the closure denominator is the composed per-vertical bundle; threshold unchanged. Measured at live HEAD fabb9f0a6 with comments stripped: 7054/7072 = 99.75% (the ruling quotes 7055/7073: its count includes --ds-affix-affixed-shadow, which every bundle carries only inside a comment).
